longDescription: Independent experimental ImageSlide GIF fork by ggazzeta, based on Santiago Pérez (MIT), with fully independent per-profile preferences and preserved legacy migration/rollback. Windows x64 and macOS x64/arm64 native dependencies are packaged and statically verified. The user reports 0.9.0 PNG frames works on one physical D200, while Native GIF freezes; 0.10.0 profile playback conflicts were reported; 0.10.1 display ownership correction awaits physical switching validation. Native GIF, bounded PNG frames and poster modes preserve gallery, clock, weather and system panels. Setup is a private profile technique with exact Windows build pins; macOS users reopen Studio manually and the clock overlay can remain visible. No store submission or broad hardware-verified claim is made. Technique attribution: https://github.com/chilleno/claude-deck.
